baseline_models.focus_anchor: The doubled ن ز ل construction at words 2 and 13 encloses جُند at word 8 and السَّمَاء at word 10 under two negations.
baseline_models.mechanism: Bringing something down from the overshadowing height supplies a delivery path, while جند supplies a mutually supporting collective payload. Their combination makes the denial target an entire celestial deployment chain rather than merely report that soldiers were absent.

activation_trace.role: Delivery or bringing-down supplies both the denied action and its emphatic repetition.
A mutually supporting gathered force is the payload explicitly excluded from that delivery.
The sky as what is high and overshadowing fixes the denied force's vertical source.

changed_reading.before: No army was sent down from heaven.
changed_reading.after: The ayah emphatically rules out a mediated operation with a high source, a massed payload, and a downward delivery path.

baseline_models.focus_anchor: وَمَا كُنَّا مُنزِلِينَ at words 11-13 adds a state-of-being denial after the event denial.
baseline_models.mechanism: The temporal state carried by ك و ن combines with the battle-descent branch of ن ز ل. The second clause therefore reaches beyond this occasion and rejects descending for combat as an instantiated or characteristic operating mode.

activation_trace.role: Occurrence or presence in time turns the second negation into a denial of being in that operational state.
Descent for battle sharpens what kind of sending the state clause disclaims.

changed_reading.before: God did not send an army on this occasion.
changed_reading.after: The wording presents troop-descent as a mode God was not employing, rather than as a force He lacked.

baseline_models.focus_anchor: قَوْمِهِ مِن بَعْدِهِ at words 4-6 places one absent individual against his continuing collective.
baseline_models.mechanism: ق و م supplies the gathered human body, while ب ع د supplies the interval after a prior term. The possessive pronouns preserve the individual's relation to the group even as the temporal construction removes him from their present.

activation_trace.role: The people form the surviving collective against which the singular pronoun is measured.
The after-versus-before branch marks a successor interval opened by his removal.

changed_reading.after: After him is a relational hinge: the one is gone, his bond to the people remains, and the collective is left without any descending counter-collective.

context_deltas.mechanism: The surah first affirms a تنزيل, then sends human messengers, while the townspeople claim that the Merciful sent down nothing. The focus echoes their syntax but replaces the unrestricted شيء with the precise جند, correcting their category: communicative descent is affirmed and coercive military descent is denied.

activation_trace.role: Affirmed delivery from above establishes descent as a positive channel before the focus denial.
Dispatch and being dispatched supply human emissaries as the chosen mediated channel.
The same delivery branch carries the people's overbroad claim that the Merciful sent down no thing.
The doubled focus occurrence narrows the denied delivery to a specific payload.
The gathered supporting force is the precise payload excluded, in contrast to revelation and envoys.

structural_cues: 36:15 and 36:28 repeat the pattern وَمَا أَنزَلَ ... مِن, but the earlier object is unrestricted شيء and the focus object is جند.
36:5 affirmatively names a تنزيل, and 36:14 twice marks the envoys with ر س ل.
context_deltas.reader_inference: The packet supplies affirmed descent, dispatched messengers, the people's universal denial, and the focus's narrowed denial. I infer that 36:28 corrects their category by separating revelatory and emissary transmission from military coercion. Alternatively, the verbal echo may serve local irony without defining a general economy of descent.

changed_reading.after: The ayah answers the earlier claim that the Merciful sent down nothing: guidance did arrive through revelation and envoys, but not as a coercive celestial host.

context_deltas.mechanism: The absent plural host is followed immediately by one alarming cry and collective extinction. The same one-cry formula later gathers everyone into presence, turning singular signal versus massed force into a repeated execution pattern: no deployment, only a minimal command-like event with total reach.

activation_trace.role: The mutually supporting plurality supplies the large-scale instrument explicitly denied.
The frightening cry supplies the actual event that immediately follows the denied host.
Numerical oneness creates the scalar reversal from a collective army to one signal.
Life stilled after motion supplies the cry's comprehensive result.
The repeated alarming cry extends the same non-military mechanism to the surah's later horizon.
Repeated numerical singularity confirms that total scope does not require a massed instrument.
Gathering the dispersed supplies the total population-scale reach of the single event.
Presence and proximity supply the endpoint produced without troop transport.

structural_cues: 36:29 is immediately adjacent to the focus and begins with an exclusory singular formula.
36:53 repeats إِن كَانَتْ إِلَّا صَيْحَةً وَاحِدَةً but changes the result from extinguished to all brought present.
context_deltas.reader_inference: The packet supplies the denied host, an immediately succeeding one cry, extinction, and a later one cry producing universal presence. I infer that the cry functionally replaces military deployment as the effective instrument. Alternatively, the formula may emphasize suddenness alone rather than invite an explicit comparison of means.

changed_reading.before: No host was needed because the people were destroyed suddenly.
changed_reading.after: The ayah sets up a scalar reversal: a massed celestial force is denied, while one signal repeatedly proves sufficient for extinction and universal assembly.

context_deltas.mechanism: Near the surah's end, hoped-for aid fails and جند returns as a host already brought present. The lexical reversal contrasts an absent divinely deployed host with a present but powerless auxiliary body, separating numerical muster from effective power.

activation_trace.role: The focus excludes a mutually supporting gathered force descending from above.
Expected aid and making-victorious supply the purpose for which the alternative gods were taken.
Negated aid removes effective support from the later host relation.
The exact host branch returns, now attached to a failed economy of assistance.
Being brought present contrasts sharply with the focus host that never descends.

structural_cues: جند occurs only in the focus and in 36:75 within the supplied whole-surah packet.
The later occurrence is bracketed by inability and negated نصر, then qualified by محضرون.
context_deltas.reader_inference: The packet supplies hoped-for help, inability to help, a host relation, and enforced presence. I infer that the late recurrence answers the focus by exposing a mustered auxiliary as powerless even when present. The live alternative is the pronoun direction: the worshippers may be the host presented for the gods, or the gods may be construed as the host presented for the worshippers.

changed_reading.before: No divine army descended against the people.
changed_reading.after: The surah does not equate a host with power: the divine host is unnecessary and absent, while the only other host is already present yet cannot deliver the aid expected of it.

context_deltas.mechanism: The ending joins creation of the heavens and earth to capacity, then compresses efficacy into command, saying, and occurrence: كُن فَيَكُونُ. This return of ك و ن clarifies the focus's وَمَا كُنَّا مُنزِلِينَ as a choice of operating mode, because direct command-to-occurrence makes force-delivery logistics unnecessary.

activation_trace.role: The focus uses temporal being or occurrence to deny inhabiting the state of army-senders.
Delivery from above supplies the logistical mode that the focus excludes.
The heavens appear as a created high domain, not as an independent reservoir of force.
Capacity reaching effective action blocks any reading of the focus negation as inability.
Command and binding demand supply the initiating act in the final efficacy sequence.
Articulated saying supplies the minimal mediating act between will and result.
Imperative being followed by occurrence supplies direct realization without transported auxiliaries.

structural_cues: The focus's كُنَّا and the ending's كُن فَيَكُونُ repeat ك و ن in opposing constructions: denied operating state versus commanded occurrence.
36:81 explicitly establishes capacity immediately before 36:82 states the command-to-occurrence sequence.
context_deltas.reader_inference: The packet supplies creative capacity, command, speech, and immediate occurrence. I infer that this final sequence retrospectively explains why descending an army is not the operative mode in 36:28. Alternatively, 36:81-82 may address resurrection generally without serving as a direct gloss on the earlier town episode.

changed_reading.before: God happened not to deploy a celestial army.
changed_reading.after: The negation marks a mismatch of means, not a deficit of power: divine efficacy runs directly from command to occurrence, so an army's transport and mediation are superfluous.

context_deltas.mechanism: The later celestial sequence presents flowing motion, measured determination, lunar منازل, and bodies swimming in a celestial course. The same ن ز ل inventory that names descent in the focus names ordered stations at 36:39, shifting the sky from imagined host storage to a calibrated system of placed movements.

activation_trace.role: The high overshadowing sky is the domain whose military use the focus denies.
A gathered supporting force supplies the militarized picture removed from that domain.
Continuous flowing motion supplies a lawful celestial process rather than a troop sortie.
Ordering an affair by measure supplies the governing logic of the celestial process.
Stations or dwellings redirect the focus root from downward delivery toward calibrated placement.
The celestial sphere and course supply the bounded track in which the bodies move.
Running or swimming supplies coordinated motion within that track.

structural_cues: 36:38-40 is a continuous celestial sequence built from motion, measure, stations, non-overtaking, and shared courses.
مَنَازِل in 36:39 reuses the focus root ن ز ل inside that ordered sequence.
context_deltas.reader_inference: The packet supplies the sky-denial and a later measured celestial system with ن ز ل stations. I infer that the later sequence demilitarizes the focus sky by presenting its operative image as calibrated order rather than barracks. Alternatively, the celestial signs may be thematically independent of the town's punishment.

changed_reading.before: No troops came from a location called heaven.
changed_reading.after: The surah's heaven is configured as measured courses and stations, so the focus denies a militarized sky and locates effective power in calibrated ordering.

surprising_valid_outliers.containment: This spatializes temporal بَعْد and treats entry into the garden as a counter-direction to descent, although 36:26 does not explicitly narrate ascent. It remains anchored because one man comes from the city's far edge, enters the garden, and is immediately followed by the denial of any host descending after him. Downstream prose should present this only as a spatial-temporal counterpoint, not as a literal itinerary.
surprising_valid_outliers.focus_anchor: مِن بَعْدِهِ مِن جُندٍ مِنَ السَّمَاءِ places the absent one, his remaining people, and a denied vertical collective in one construction.

activation_trace.role: The farthest side supplies the remote horizontal origin of the lone human intervention.
One male person supplies singular human agency against the later absent collective force.
Purposeful movement toward a goal makes the man's arrival an active crossing.
Entry into an interior supplies the man's second directed transition.
The tree-screened garden supplies the destination of that singular entry.
The successor interval directly binds the denied deployment to what follows the man.
Downward movement supplies the counter-direction that no host traverses.
The massed supporting body supplies the collective crossing explicitly absent.

changed_reading.before: After the man, no army descended.
changed_reading.after: A lone man crosses inward from the civic edge and enters the garden, while no collective crosses downward from the sky after him; authority moves through asymmetric singular passages, not massed intervention.

surprising_valid_outliers.containment: This uses the rare rough-stony-ground branch of جند, not its ordinary force sense, so it is deliberately branch-distant. It remains anchored because the community earlier threatens رجم, the focus denies a sky-jund, and the next ayah supplies a cry instead. Downstream prose must label it a material anti-mirroring possibility and must not translate جند as stones.
surprising_valid_outliers.focus_anchor: جُندٍ مِنَ السَّمَاءِ joins the rare stony جند branch to a source above while emphatically denying its descent.

activation_trace.role: Grouped stones activate the material image latent in the community's threatened رجم.
Rough stony ground makes the denied host a possible material echo rather than only a military one.
The sky fixes the above-to-below source of the material retaliation being denied.
The frightening cry supplies the non-stony event that actually follows.

changed_reading.before: The people's punishment did not require an army.
changed_reading.after: The people threaten stone violence, yet their end is not a mirrored stony mass from above; the denied جند can function as an anti-image of retaliatory lapidation displaced by sound.

surprising_valid_outliers.containment: This follows the packet's non-dominant س م و to و س م mapping, so its rain-marking image is not a direct gloss of السَّمَاء. It remains valid as an activation because the packet later opposes sky and earth, revives dead earth, and foregrounds green growth. Downstream prose should call it a form-distant ecological polarity, not lexical equivalence.
surprising_valid_outliers.focus_anchor: The split inventory for the focus's س م و at word 10 includes first rain marking earth with vegetation, while the same clause denies a host from that source.

activation_trace.role: First rain that marks earth with vegetation supplies a life-bearing alternative to military descent.
The gathered force supplies the punitive payload rejected from the life-marking source.
Earth as the lower counterpart to sky supplies the receiving field of the ecological polarity.
Earth's life through rain and growth supplies the later realization of the marking image.
Fresh green vegetation keeps the life-bearing register active at the surah's close.

changed_reading.before: Heaven is simply the place from which no army came.
changed_reading.after: A form-distant branch lets the denied military descent polarize with the surah's life-marking sky-to-earth economy: what the upper source marks below is living growth, not a host.

strongest_changes: The verbal echo with 36:15 narrows the people's claim that the Merciful sent down nothing: revelation and envoys are affirmed, only the coercive host is denied.
The immediate and repeated one-cry formula converts absent plural force into singular signal with collective reach.
The remote جند recurrence at 36:75 contrasts the absent divine host with a present but powerless auxiliary body.
كُن فَيَكُونُ retrospectively makes وَمَا كُنَّا مُنزِلِينَ a statement about direct command as operating mode, not lack of capacity.
summary.what_was_special: The whole-surah packet exposed remote lexical returns that a local window could miss: جند becomes powerless when present, ك و ن returns as direct command-to-occurrence, and ن ز ل returns as measured celestial stations. Together they make 36:28 a claim about mode, scale, and the false equation of muster with power.
remaining_uncertainties: The pronoun direction in 36:75 leaves open whether the worshippers are the host presented for the gods or the gods are construed as the host presented for the worshippers.
The measured celestial sequence may be an intentional retrospective contrast with 36:28 or only a compatible thematic analogy.
The solitary-crossing, stony anti-mirroring, and life-marking sky readings depend on spatialization or branch-distant mappings and must remain explicitly exploratory.
